name: eyemouse-extension
description: Controle o cursor do mouse e execute cliques utilizando rastreamento ocular via webcam.

scripts.dev: rimraf dist && concurrently -n main,content -c blue,green "vite build --watch" "vite build --watch --config vite.content.config.js"
scripts.build: rimraf dist && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.js
